categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Capchem Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: battery chemicals, organic fluorochemicals, capacitor chemicals, and semiconductor chemicals. These segments focus on the research, production, sales, and service of new electronic chemicals and functional materials, serving industries such as new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, pharmaceuticals, digital infrastructure, and industrial manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including proprietary synthesis, purification, formulation development, and integrated green chemical processes such as the ECOSIPTM green integrated process for carbonate solvents. It holds numerous patents in lithium-ion battery electrolytes, additives, fluoropolymers, and semiconductor chemicals. Production methods emphasize high purity, environmental compliance, and innovation in materials like solid-state electrolytes, sodium-ion battery electrolytes, and high-performance fluorochemicals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global manufacturers in the new energy vehicle sector, energy storage systems, consumer electronics, semiconductor industry, and pharmaceutical and chemical industries. The company serves downstream markets such as electric vehicles, energy storage, consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, wearables), industrial automation, and semiconductor fabrication.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production bases in China (Guangdong, Jiangsu, Fujian, Hubei, Hunan, Tianjin, Chongqing), Europe (Poland), the United States, Singapore, South Korea, and Hong Kong. It maintains offices and subsidiaries in key international markets to provide localized services and rapid response to customer needs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Capchem operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing critical chemical materials and functional components for lithium-ion batteries, capacitors, organic fluorochemicals, and semiconductor chemicals. It also extends upstream by investing in key raw materials such as lithium hexafluorophosphate and fluorochemicals, ensuring supply chain integration and security.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on high-energy-density battery electrolytes, solid-state and sodium-ion battery materials, high-performance fluoropolymers, and semiconductor chemicals. It emphasizes proprietary technology development, patent acquisition, and collaboration with academic and industrial partners to maintain competitive advantages and support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products and functional materials to industrial customers. The company operates a direct sales model supplemented by technical service and customized solution offerings. It also engages in strategic investments and licensing related to its proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in the lithium-ion battery electrolyte segment include Tianqi Lithium and Ruike New Materials. Shenzhen Capchem is positioned as a leading supplier with strong technological capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and global production capacity. It holds a significant market share in aluminum electrolytic capacitor chemicals and organic fluorochemicals, maintaining a competitive edge through innovation and internationalization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 7.85 billion, representing a 4.85% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 942 million, a slight decline due to industry price pressures and increased operational costs. The company has steadily expanded production capacity, with ongoing investments in new projects domestically and internationally, supporting a growth trajectory aligned with global new energy and semiconductor market trends.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shenzhen Capchem emphasizes high-quality, high-purity chemical products with proprietary technologies that enhance battery performance, safety, and longevity. Its integrated supply chain and global production footprint enable reliable and localized supply. The company offers customized solutions and technical support, differentiating itself through innovation, comprehensive product portfolios, and strong customer relationships with leading global manufacturers.
